BillHeading.BriefDescription: Repealing income eligibility for temporary assistance for needy families benefits for a child who lives with a nonparent caregiver.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to income eligibility for temporary assistance for needy families benefits for a child who lives with a nonparent caregiver; and repealing RCW 74.12.037.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 74.12.037 (Income eligibility—Unearned income exemption) and 2014 c 75 s 1 & 2011 1st sp.s. c 42 s 4 are each repealed.
